_comment: 'Pre-registered' is the whole point and it is a claim about time, not about
format: SC-736 says the paraphrase corpus 'is fixed before implementation',
and a corpus assembled after the fact is a description of what the code
already does. So this file records what each corpus must cover and how big
it must be, committed before the code that has to satisfy it, and a test
that finds a corpus smaller or narrower than its entry here fails.
Entries name where the corpus lives. Some already exist and are referenced
rather than duplicated; the rest are owed by the tasks named in 'owed_by',
and their absence is a missing corpus rather than a passing test.

key_variants.requires: at least fifty variant groups; zero variant pairs produce two subjects
notes: Groups are internally consistent: all dotted or all dotless. A group
mixing them would assert a folding that must never happen, because a
dot separates topic segments and a hyphen does not.

privacy_classes.requires: every rejection class exercised; zero secrets persisted; refusals structurally text-free
notes: Each entry must match its own class and no earlier one, since
`matched_class` reports the first match. That is asserted, not assumed:
an example tripping an earlier check would leave a later class
untested while every assertion still passed.

path_attacks.requires: every listed form refused on both POSIX and Windows shapes; bounds stated as numbers
notes: Each attack is paired with the path its 'obvious fix' would produce,
and that repaired form is asserted legal — which is exactly why
repairing silently would be undetectable downstream.

legacy_keys.criterion: SC-746 (un-normalized legacy keys produce no second record)
legacy_keys.requires: seeded from a real v7-era store, not a v8 store containing an old-looking string
must_cover: a genuinely different value that must still conflict
notes: The fixture writes through the v7 schema and then migrates, so the row
was written by code that predates the folding. A v8 fixture holding an
old-looking string would pass without proving anything.

reference_identity.requires: one UUID shared across project, personal, team and pattern, on every surface carrying a reference

capture_matrix.requires: every supported agent against every canonical event kind, with a disposition for each cell

decision_signals.requires: vocabulary-justified tokens accepted, sentence fragments and credentials refused
must_cover: token justified by a file segment
token justified by a command verb
token justified by an established project key
token justified only by a later event
a sentence rendered in the key charset
a credential rendered in the key charset
decision_signals.owed_by: T040-T064 (US1) extends this to the extraction side
notes: The ingest half is present. What is owed is the extraction half: that
an accepted signal actually produces the decision it names.

paraphrase_pairs.requires: at least fifty claim pairs spanning all five knowledge kinds; a restatement reinforces rather than creating a record
notes: SC-736 says the corpus is fixed before implementation. This entry is
that fixing: the shape and the size are committed now, and the pairs
are written before the consolidation code that has to satisfy them —
not chosen afterwards from the cases it happens to handle.

restart_injection.requires: a crash at each stage of a consolidation pass leaves no duplicate and strands no session

migration_stores.requires: populated v7 stores covering every retained-local reason and every blocked-row report
